summary: Grupo TMM filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release reporting first-quarter 2026 financial results. The release discusses consolidated revenues of Ps 290.7 million, operating results of Ps 25.6 million, and net income of Ps 1.9 million, along with operational updates and an outlook. No transaction, strategic review, activist campaign, or other special-situation event is described. The filing is a routine earnings release by a foreign issuer, not a special-situation disclosure.
